hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook implementing a custom bonding curve backed by Euler vault assets. Swaps are handled entirely in beforeSwap: it computes output via a custom curve (CurveLib), deposits input tokens into and withdraws output tokens from Euler vaults, and returns the full BeforeSwapDelta, bypassing standard AMM pricing. Add-liquidity and donate are blocked to prevent unproductive positions.
